cases.title: Git HTTPS/Schannel handshake failure
cases.observed_failure: Network transport failure was confused with GitHub authentication.
cases.required_prevention: Probe gh auth and Git transport separately; safe HTTP/1.1/OpenSSL fallbacks without disabling TLS.

cases.title: GitHub CLI auth versus Git credential setup
cases.observed_failure: gh auth was valid while ordinary Git still needed setup.
cases.required_prevention: Run gh auth status, gh auth setup-git, API identity check, and git ls-remote as separate gates.

cases.title: WindowsApps fake bash
cases.observed_failure: bash.exe existed but /bin/bash did not.
cases.required_prevention: Capability-test GNU Bash; otherwise use an equivalent Windows validator.

cases.title: powershell.exe used instead of pwsh
cases.observed_failure: Windows PowerShell lacked required APIs.
cases.required_prevention: Resolve and require PowerShell 7 for runtime scripts.

cases.title: Unsupported runtime-update mode
cases.observed_failure: Manifest writer accepted only new/adopt.
cases.required_prevention: Schema and writer parity tests for every installation mode.

cases.title: Repository docs scan applied to runtime overlay
cases.observed_failure: Runtime package lacked repository-only docs and failed.
cases.required_prevention: Use runtime-specific validation profile; full docs scan only for source/release.

cases.title: PowerShell literal interpolation in verifier
cases.observed_failure: `$true` inside a double-quoted marker became `True`.
cases.required_prevention: Use single-quoted literals or AST/regex checks with literal escaping.

cases.title: Dirty runtime root rejected after framework update
cases.observed_failure: Bootstrap treated expected framework changes as product dirtiness.
cases.required_prevention: Separate runtime root, product worktree, and reviewed framework-owned changes.

cases.title: Unicode stdout path corruption
cases.observed_failure: Python UTF-8 path was decoded incorrectly by PowerShell.
cases.required_prevention: Exchange paths through UTF-8 JSON/result files, not parsed console text.

cases.title: Temporary extraction root selected as project authority
cases.observed_failure: Handoff bound to the package rather than the live project.
cases.required_prevention: Project scoring and explicit logical project/root identities.

cases.title: Git stderr mixed with porcelain stdout
cases.observed_failure: Warning text was treated as a dirty path.
cases.required_prevention: Capture stdout/stderr separately; parse porcelain v2 -z or NUL-safe output.

cases.title: PowerShell variable-colon parser error
cases.observed_failure: `$ExpectedTag:` parsed as an invalid variable reference.
cases.required_prevention: Use `${ExpectedTag}:` or format strings; parser-test every script.

cases.title: Automatic `$Args` collision
cases.observed_failure: Case-insensitive `$Args` collided with `$args`.
cases.required_prevention: AST gate for automatic variables in parameters, assignments, loops and splats.

cases.title: Automatic `$input` collision
cases.observed_failure: Hooks and scripts used `$input` as a normal variable.
cases.required_prevention: Rename inputs and enforce AST gate.

cases.title: Automatic variable used as parameter name
cases.observed_failure: Hook functions declared `$input`/`$args` parameters.
cases.required_prevention: PowerShell runtime-contract validator must reject.

cases.title: Generic List wrapped in `@()`
cases.observed_failure: PowerShell raised Argument types do not match.
cases.required_prevention: Use `.ToArray()` or explicit enumeration; regression with singleton and multiple values.

cases.title: Missing Companion contract markers
cases.observed_failure: Runtime Truth rejected missing Completion/Executor discovery sections.
cases.required_prevention: Contract marker test over exact built Companion package.

cases.title: Wrong active Companion filename
cases.observed_failure: Validator expected GPT55 while active file was GPT56.
cases.required_prevention: Manifest-driven active-file discovery, no hard-coded stale filename.

cases.title: Version surfaces diverged
cases.observed_failure: Config, README, installer, tests and packages showed different versions.
cases.required_prevention: One ECOSYSTEM_VERSION source and exhaustive active-surface gate.

cases.title: Duplicate version matrices drifted
cases.observed_failure: docs and docs/reference copies differed.
cases.required_prevention: Single canonical source or byte-parity check.

cases.title: Trailing blank line blocked release
cases.observed_failure: git diff --check stopped on docs-only whitespace.
cases.required_prevention: Operational profile treats documentation-only whitespace as advisory; strict CI remains available.

cases.title: Markdown formatting treated as operational failure
cases.observed_failure: Harmless docs formatting repeatedly blocked deployment.
cases.required_prevention: Separate operational and strict-release gates.

cases.title: Broken active Markdown links
cases.observed_failure: Moved docs left stale links.
cases.required_prevention: Link checker over exact extracted package.

cases.title: Golden-case baseline stale
cases.observed_failure: Case set and recorded source hash differed.
cases.required_prevention: Recompute from exact source; baseline parity gate.

cases.title: Placeholder tests
cases.observed_failure: `assert True`, `pass`, or callable-only checks produced false green.
cases.required_prevention: Behavioral tests plus AST meta-test.

cases.title: Import errors silently passed
cases.observed_failure: Required modules could fail to import without failing tests.
cases.required_prevention: No silent ImportError in required acceptance tests.

cases.title: Conditional no-op tests
cases.observed_failure: Missing evidence files caused test bodies to skip.
cases.required_prevention: Assert prerequisites exist or fail.

cases.title: Synthetic fixture labeled real H10
cases.observed_failure: A sanitised fixture was presented as current product evidence.
cases.required_prevention: Real/synthetic provenance field and forbidden label mismatch.

cases.title: Manual queue injection labeled real Desktop Stop
cases.observed_failure: Simulation was claimed as same-surface evidence.
cases.required_prevention: Trigger provenance and manual-injection flags.

cases.title: Attestation created before evidence
cases.observed_failure: Hashes and timestamps did not match delivered artifacts.
cases.required_prevention: Create attestation last and freeze all attested files.

cases.title: Source package not equal to executing code
cases.observed_failure: Final handoff came from edits made after source package build.
cases.required_prevention: Bind source identity/generation to outputs.

cases.title: Result identity bound to wrong worktree
cases.observed_failure: Governance root was used instead of product root.
cases.required_prevention: Separate result worktree and runtime root.

cases.title: Missing primary artifact falsely accepted
cases.observed_failure: Required ZIP absence was downgraded.
cases.required_prevention: Fail-closed artifact contract; verification debt is not acceptance.

cases.title: Invented `/new-goal` command
cases.observed_failure: Readiness depended on a command absent from inventory.
cases.required_prevention: Inventory/capability based routing only.

cases.title: Runtime root and result worktree conflated
cases.observed_failure: One selected worktree served incompatible purposes.
cases.required_prevention: Explicit logical project, runtime root, result worktree and artifact root.

cases.title: Empty session delta marked READY
cases.observed_failure: Conversation context was absent while readiness was green.
cases.required_prevention: Non-empty delta or explicit no-new-events receipt.

cases.title: Exporter dialogue root wrong
cases.observed_failure: Telegram workspace was authority for companion-handoff changes.
cases.required_prevention: Write-root scoring and objective coherence.

cases.title: UX helper not wired
cases.observed_failure: ZIP existed but clipboard/explorer/notification chain was incomplete.
cases.required_prevention: Worker-to-UX integration test with returned archive path.

cases.title: Worker reconstructed archive path
cases.observed_failure: Multi-root result could be delivered from wrong folder.
cases.required_prevention: Use exporter-returned archive_path only.

cases.title: H10 names leaked into generic Pipeline
cases.observed_failure: Universal release scripts contained product-specific paths.
cases.required_prevention: Generic config/registry and leakage test.

cases.title: Writer/schema revision mismatch
cases.observed_failure: WORK_ITEM writer produced fields disallowed by active schema.
cases.required_prevention: Writer-shaped fixtures validated by production schema.

cases.title: StrictMode property assignment on legacy state
cases.observed_failure: Updater assigned missing PSCustomObject properties directly.
cases.required_prevention: Add-Member/upsert helper and legacy-shape regression.

cases.title: Checkout SHA compared across CRLF
cases.observed_failure: File identity failed despite identical Git blob.
cases.required_prevention: Compare Git blob identity or normalized content.

cases.title: Git path parsing dropped first character
cases.observed_failure: `docs/...` became `ocs/...`.
cases.required_prevention: NUL-delimited path parsing; first-entry regression.

cases.title: Validation-created pycache dirtied repo
cases.observed_failure: Release builder rejected generated caches.
cases.required_prevention: Put caches outside checkout or clean proven ephemeral paths before cleanliness gate.

cases.title: Validators mutate source checkout
cases.observed_failure: Latest run left six tracked files modified after validation.
cases.required_prevention: Per-test before/after hashes and full-sequence immutability regression.

cases.title: Public release identity drift
cases.observed_failure: Main moved beyond tag/release and assets.
cases.required_prevention: Immutable tag policy; promote new unified version when necessary.

cases.title: Partial success after push
cases.observed_failure: Main was pushed but deployment and release refresh stopped.
cases.required_prevention: State-aware resume with explicit completed-step receipts.

cases.title: GitHub token expired
cases.observed_failure: Code patch cycle was unnecessary.
cases.required_prevention: Credential preflight and one browser re-auth flow.

cases.title: Rollback not proven exact
cases.observed_failure: Failed updates risked leaving mixed state.
cases.required_prevention: Transactional backup, exact pre/post hashes, rollback verification.

cases.title: Interrupted update backup confusion
cases.observed_failure: New attempts risked using wrong backup.
cases.required_prevention: Persist operation identity and resume original backup.

cases.title: Release asset parity incomplete
cases.observed_failure: Local, repo and GitHub packages could differ.
cases.required_prevention: Download and hash exact release assets after publication.

cases.title: ZIP action packet incompatible with UI
cases.observed_failure: Antigravity attachment filter did not accept ZIP workflow.
cases.required_prevention: Use JSON action packet and automatic Downloads import.

cases.title: Action Bridge not end-to-end proven
cases.observed_failure: Import/injection/replay flow was mostly conceptual.
cases.required_prevention: Real worker, scheduled task, schema, activation and canary tests.

cases.title: Repair budget required owner approval
cases.observed_failure: Owner was asked to approve internal batch 4/4.
cases.required_prevention: Progress/no-progress policy; no numeric budget in owner interaction.

cases.title: Owner output excessively technical
cases.observed_failure: Comments were low-value to a non-specialist.
cases.required_prevention: Four plain-language sections; technical detail only in action packet/evidence.

cases.title: Execution lease detected writes after the fact
cases.observed_failure: Pre-write control was advisory.
cases.required_prevention: Executable PreToolUse/PreInvocation guard before mutation.

cases.title: Malformed findings ignored by closure compiler
cases.observed_failure: Unknown lifecycle/materiality could disappear.
cases.required_prevention: Fail-closed schema validation before route/closure.

cases.title: Audit matrix incomplete but consumed
cases.observed_failure: Initial audit was not comprehensive.
cases.required_prevention: Coverage completeness validator before audit state transition.

cases.title: Work-item activation non-atomic
cases.observed_failure: Work item, lease, firewall and handshake drifted.
cases.required_prevention: Transactional activation with rollback.

cases.title: Candidate manifest included ambient dirtiness
cases.observed_failure: Unrelated runtime files polluted product candidate.
cases.required_prevention: Lease-scoped candidate manifest and separate ambient inventory.

cases.title: Validation stopped on first issue
cases.observed_failure: User runs discovered errors serially.
cases.required_prevention: Aggregate preflight failures before mutation.

cases.title: Companion deployment mistaken for canonical source
cases.observed_failure: Downloads staging appeared authoritative.
cases.required_prevention: Repository source -> built asset -> derivative deployment model.

cases.title: Tag/release/current main mismatch
cases.observed_failure: Published tag could identify an older commit.
cases.required_prevention: Release identity audit and immutable-version policy.

cases.title: Runtime updater risked product leakage
cases.observed_failure: Broad Replace changed project docs/contracts.
cases.required_prevention: Strict framework-owned allowlist and product baseline comparison.

cases.title: Local main/origin/tag drift
cases.observed_failure: Different refs were treated as one state.
cases.required_prevention: Explicit ref equality and release target checks.

cases.title: Many obsolete kits in Downloads
cases.observed_failure: Wrong package was repeatedly launched.
cases.required_prevention: Archive superseded kits and publish one canonical deployment entry point.

cases.title: No authoritative live-state snapshot
cases.observed_failure: Static handoffs went stale.
cases.required_prevention: Read-only live-state collector at every major resume.

cases.title: No same-surface canary
cases.observed_failure: Simulation was used instead of real integration.
cases.required_prevention: Real queue/worker/hook canary where feasible.

cases.title: Resume scripts repeated or diverged
cases.observed_failure: Patch chain became non-idempotent.
cases.required_prevention: One state machine, completed-step receipts, and idempotent second run.
